meta.name: docs
meta.description: Decide which family a doc belongs to before drafting — SDK/developer, user/product, or working-group (WG) — since family sets the audience, home, and tone. Use when creating, moving, or restructuring docs, when unsure which directory a doc belongs in, or when a request says "document this" / "write docs for X" without naming the kind. Routes to the specialized skill for each family.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断文档类型并路由到对应写作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动笔前确定文档的受众和风格
copy.tagline_en: Classify docs by family before drafting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide the audience and tone of a document before writing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先判断文档属于哪个类别（SDK/开发者、用户/产品、工作组），再根据类别决定写作风格和存放位置，并自动转给对应的专门技能。
howto.when: 当你要求“写文档”、“记录这个”或“整理文档”，但没说具体类型时触发；也适用于移动或重组文档时。

say.note: Claude会先判断是SDK类，然后按开发者文档风格撰写。

say.text: 给这个功能写用户指南
say.note: Claude会归为用户/产品类，并调用对应的用户文档技能。

say.text: 记录这个设计决策的原因
say.note: Claude会归为工作组类，并转给工作组文档技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first decides which family a doc belongs to (SDK/developer, user/product, or working-group), then determines tone and location based on that family, and routes to the specialized skill for that family.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "document this", "write docs for X" without specifying the kind, or when creating, moving, or restructuring docs.

say_en.note: Claude classifies as SDK and writes developer docs.

say_en.text: Create a user guide for this feature.
say_en.note: Claude classifies as user/product and routes to user docs skill.

say_en.text: Document why this design decision was made.
say_en.note: Claude classifies as WG and routes to WG docs skill.
